name: sound id lookup
reason: the path it builds is checked as a virtual path (too long or non-ASCII or rooted or with .. is refused) where the original builds it unchecked

name: sound init
reason: only the files it loads (by load phase) and the positional parameters; the listener and channel volumes belong to the player (ARC-UI-040); a missing or unreadable or malformed table or scheme file and an empty or non-ASCII table name refuse the catalogue (project policy) where the original only checks that the index has entries

name: scheme load
reason: only the index lookup and the records it reads; slot choice and starting songs belong to the player (ARC-UI-041); the 25-record limit is checked here and a 26th record is refused instead of the original's crash; a list base of 0 or less or near the int32 limit is refused (project policy)

name: scheme record parse
reason: the record limit and appending to the scheme are done by the caller; a resource that would overflow the path later built from it is refused

name: critter resistance
reason: a critter's resistances without the resistance effects and without the display form that leaves out unidentified magickal armour

name: kill experience award
reason: only the award to the killer's PC (a fifth of the victim's worth); the rest of the kill notification is not modelled

name: experience award
reason: only the difficulty change of the award; the PC test and the award's effects and setter stay with the session

name: level recalculation
reason: a PC without an auto-level scheme or effects on its level

name: follower level update
reason: the follower's level and points; its auto-level scheme is not run

name: damage experience share
reason: only the experience-pool share of a hit and without the 32-bit wrap of worth × percentage that no installed worth reaches

name: skill level
reason: the five combat skills keyed on dexterity; the caller passes the effect changes of the skill (none are modelled yet)

name: skill training
reason: the five combat skills; the caller passes the effective melee level and character level

name: dialogue voice start
reason: only the file choice (path and the female to male fallback); stopping and playing the voice belong to the player (ARC-UI-043)
